longdesc:
Uses fence_virsh to fence a guest node managed by libvirt. Create a
separate resource for each guest node in the cluster. The cluster
nodes must be able to log in to the hypervisor over SSH. virsh must be
installed on the hypervisor, and the SSH user must have permission to
manage the guest. Use the libvirt domain name or UUID, which may
differ from the cluster node name. Note that the recommended fencing
mechanism is SBD whenever a shared storage device (like a SAN) is
available.
name: libvirt

parameters.longdesc: The cluster node name. The device will not run on its target node.
parameters.name: target
parameters.shortdesc: Node to Manage With STONITH Device

parameters.longdesc: Address of the libvirt hypervisor to connect to over SSH.
parameters.name: ip
username
parameters.shortdesc: SSH login name on the hypervisor

parameters.longdesc:
The domain name or UUID shown by virsh list --all on the hypervisor.
The cluster node name is mapped to this domain using pcmk_host_map.
parameters.name: plug

parameters.longdesc:
Path to the SSH private key on every cluster node that may run the
device. Leave unset to use the SSH client's default identity files.
parameters.name: identity_file
